A total of 16 teams contested the league. [[ES Sétif]] came into the season as defending champions of the [[2014–15 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2014–15 season]]. [[USM Blida]], [[DRB Tadjenanet]], and [[RC Relizane]] entered as the three promoted teams from the [[2014–15 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 2]]. On 30 April 2016, [[USM Alger]] officially won the title for professional league.
